name: Nextcloud
description: Files, calendar, contacts and collaboration on your own server (compose stack with MariaDB).

ru.description: Файлы, календарь, контакты и совместная работа на своём сервере (compose-стек с MariaDB).

composeYaml:
services:
  db:
    image: mariadb:11
    restart: unless-stopped
    command: --transaction-isolation=READ-COMMITTED --log-bin=binlog --binlog-format=ROW
    environment:
      MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      MARIADB_DATABASE: nextcloud
      MARIADB_USER: nextcloud
      MARIADB_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - dbdata:/var/lib/mysql
  app:
    image: nextcloud:30-apache
    restart: unless-stopped
    depends_on:
      - db
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    environment:
      MYSQL_HOST: db
      MYSQL_DATABASE: nextcloud
      MYSQL_USER: nextcloud
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD}
      NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_USER: ${NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_USER:-admin}
      NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_PASSWORD: ${NEXTCLOUD_ADMIN_PASSWORD}
      NEXTCLOUD_TRUSTED_DOMAINS: ${NEXTCLOUD_TRUSTED_DOMAINS:-localhost}
    volumes:
      - nextcloud:/var/www/html
volumes:
  dbdata:
  nextcloud:

meta.about: Access and share your files, calendars, contacts, mail and [more](https://apps.nextcloud.com/) from any device, on your terms.
